suppress.notes: file name: spring-boot-loader-2.7.18.jar We are pinned to Spring Boot 2.7.x on Java 17. There is no newer 2.7.x release in Maven Central, so these CVEs cannot be remediated by an in-line version bump at the moment.

Jetty 10.0.26 is the newest public Jetty 10 release available in Maven Central. CVE-2026-2332 affects Jetty 10 through 10.0.27 (commercial fix: 10.0.28); CVE-2026-6790 affects Jetty 10 through 10.0.28 (commercial fix: 10.0.29); CVE-2026-10050 affects Jetty 10 through 10.0.30 (commercial fix: 10.0.31). Advisories and fixed versions: https://jetty.org/security.html Public releases: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/eclipse/jetty/jetty-server/maven-metadata.xml No public minor/patch fix is available; public fixes require a Jetty 12 major upgrade, outside this remediation's scope. Request smuggling, authority/Host mismatch, and Digest authentication bypass remain accepted risks, not remediated vulnerabilities.

CVE-2026-123356 / GHSA-g2r5-4c8r-c84f is a false-positive OSS Index association with jetty-server 10.0.26. The advisory affects GROBID versions before 0.9.1, specifically its /api/modelTraining endpoint and GrobidRestProcessTraining thread pools, not Jetty. No Jetty minor/patch upgrade fixes this GROBID application defect. Advisory: https://github.com/grobidOrg/grobid/security/advisories/GHSA-g2r5-4c8r-c84f CVE record: https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-123356 No risk from this GROBID defect is accepted for Jetty; other Jetty vulnerabilities remain independently evaluated and existing accepted Jetty risks are not fixed.
